description: This file declares interface functions for system monitoring commands and events within a larger software project. It includes necessary type definitions and references external TCF (Target Communication Framework) types.

methods.name: handle_SysMonCommand
methods.description: Handles system monitor commands received via TCF and processes the command buffer.

methods.name: handle_SysMonEvent
methods.description: Handles system monitor events received via TCF and processes the event buffer.
